verdict.rationale: Factory documents that the App creates and "prepares" an isolated working directory for each session. Droid Computers retain installed packages, files, services and configuration between sessions, and remote delegations from Linear/Jira have Droid investigate, implement and test work, which implies an agent-managed environment. However, no evidence explicitly shows the agent cloning a repo, auto-installing dependencies, or bootstrapping its own environment configuration. missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic repo cloning, automatic dependency installation, agent-driven environment setup/configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
